summary: Submittable delay=1 fundamental-ratio alpha mined on WorldQuant Brain, avoiding TOP3000. Passes ALL in-sample submit checks; self-correlation ~0 on a fresh account. Not actually submitted (per instruction: check-only).

champion.rationale: Orthogonal value + profitability composite: cashflow-yield (cashflow_op/cap) captures cheap stocks; ROE (ebit/equity) captures quality. Each leg is ts_rank-smoothed over 40d to stabilize the quarterly fundamental signal, then cross-sectionally ranked and summed equally. No Alpha101 / classical-template reuse.

runner_up.note: Lower turnover (0.119) and higher fitness (1.08), but sub-universe Sharpe 0.76 sits exactly at the 0.76 limit (marginal). Champion chosen for its comfortable margin and cleaner equal-weight form.

method_notes: Raw cross-sectional fundamental ratios are weak (~0.3 Sharpe) on this account's IS window 2019-2023.
Wrapping a valuation ratio in ts_rank(.,40) lifts it to ~1.0 Sharpe.
TOP1000 is the sweet spot here; TOP500/TOP200 were weaker (opposite of some public notes).
Adding an ORTHOGONAL profitability signal (ROE=ebit/equity) to a cashflow-yield value signal is what breaks past SH 1.25 / FIT 1.0.
All numbers are from WorldQuant Brain /simulations (authoritative), not the local yfinance proxy.
